plan.title: Delete one of two single-stage rows

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the RFQ template so the product sheet is available.

args.goal: On the RFQ product sheet, add the first product as CYLINDER, choose CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB so Product Variant shows Default Variant, set Quantity Requested to 10 and Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), add a second row, hover the first row, click its bin icon, confirm the deletion, and stop on the sheet showing one remaining row with updated totals and the automatic title updated.

steps.note: Perform the product-specific row creation and deletion interaction that no catalog domain step can target directly.
